welcome.title: Let’s set up the app
welcome.description: We’ll go through the steps to connect to and control your PC or server.

prepare.title: Turn on the PC you want to control
prepare.description: Some setup steps must be done on the PC. Keep it nearby if possible.
prepare.note: You may need Windows administrator access.

pcHost.title: Enter your PC’s IP address
pcHost.description: The IPv4 address your phone will use to connect to the PC.
pcHost.label: PC IP address
pcHost.helpSummary: Find the IPv4 address of your current connection.
pcHost.help:
1. Open Settings on the PC.
2. Open the properties of the current connection under Network & Internet.
3. Find the IPv4 address and enter it here.

Example: 192.168.0.10
pcHost.error: Enter a valid PC IPv4 address.

pcUsername.title: Enter your Windows username
pcUsername.description: The account used to connect to the PC over SSH.
pcUsername.label: Windows username
pcUsername.helpSummary: Find the name used to sign in to Windows.
pcUsername.help:
1. Open PowerShell on the PC.
2. Run whoami.
3. Enter the name after the backslash.

Example: if whoami prints EXAMPLE-PC\windows-user, enter windows-user.

pcPortChoice.title: Have you changed the PC’s SSH port?
pcPortChoice.description: If not, use the default port 22.

pcPort.title: Enter the PC’s SSH port
pcPort.description: The port configured for the PC’s SSH server.
pcPort.label: PC SSH port
pcPort.help:
1. Open PowerShell as administrator.
2. Check the Port value in the OpenSSH server settings.
3. Use 22 if you have not changed it.

pcPrepare.title: Prepare the connection on your PC
pcPrepare.description: Run the setup tool to register this phone on your PC.
pcPrepare.shareDescription: Share or copy the setup tool URL so you can open it on your PC.
pcPrepare.task1Body: Open this setup tool URL in a browser on your PC.
pcPrepare.task2Body: Run the downloaded setup tool as administrator.

pcKey.title: Paste the connection key on your PC
pcKey.description: When the setup tool asks for the key, tap the item below to copy it, then paste it on your PC.
pcKey.copyBody: Paste the copied public key into the PC setup tool.
pcKey.action: I pasted it on the PC

pcTrust.title: Confirm this is your PC
pcTrust.description: Compare the security information shown on your PC with the information below.

connection.title: Cannot connect to the PC
connection.description: Check the PC IP address and Windows username.

auth.title: Cannot sign in to the PC
auth.description: Check that this phone’s connection key is registered on the PC.

security.title: The PC security information differs
security.description: Check the PC and current network again.

pcReady.title: PC connection confirmed
pcReady.description: You can now check and control this PC.

wakeIntent.title: Do you also want to turn on the PC from the app?
wakeIntent.description: You can shut down and restart the PC without this feature.

wakeReadiness.title: Are you ready to set up PC power on?
wakeReadiness.description: Your PC must support WOL, and your router must allow SSH access.

wakeHelp.title: Check PC power-on requirements
wakeHelp.description: There are items to check on both your PC and router.
wakeHelp.pcSummary: Check whether WOL can be used.
wakeHelp.pcBody:
1. Check Wake on LAN or PCI-E wake in BIOS/UEFI.
2. Check Wake on LAN settings in the Windows network adapter.
3. Find the wired adapter’s MAC address.
wakeHelp.routerBody:
1. Confirm you can access the router over SSH.
2. Find the LAN interface connected to the PC.
3. Confirm ether-wake is available over SSH.

mac.title: Enter your PC’s MAC address
mac.description: The address of the wired adapter that receives the wake signal.
mac.label: PC MAC address
mac.help:
1. Open network settings on the PC.
2. Open hardware properties of the wired adapter.
3. Enter its physical (MAC) address.

Example only: 02:00:00:00:00:01.

routerHost.title: Enter your router address
routerHost.description: The SSH address of the router that will run the wake command.
routerHost.label: Router address
routerHost.helpSummary: Check the default gateway on your current network.
routerHost.help:
1. Open current network information on the PC.
2. Find the default gateway IPv4 address.
3. Confirm it is the SSH destination and enter it.

Example: 192.0.2.1 (documentation address, not a real router address).

routerUsername.title: Enter the router SSH username
routerUsername.description: The account used to connect to the router over SSH.
routerUsername.label: SSH username
routerUsername.help:
1. Open the router management page.
2. Check SSH access settings.
3. Enter the SSH username. It may differ from your management login.

interface.title: Enter the LAN interface connected to the PC
interface.description: The router interface used to send the wake signal.
interface.label: LAN interface name
interface.helpSummary: Find the LAN interface connected to your PC.
interface.help:
1. Connect to the router over SSH.
2. Run ip link to list interfaces.
3. Enter the LAN interface name, such as br0 or lan0.

routerPortChoice.title: Have you changed the router’s SSH port?
routerPortChoice.description: If not, use the default port 22.

routerPort.title: Enter the router SSH port
routerPort.description: The port configured for its SSH service.
routerPort.label: SSH port
routerPort.help:
1. Open the router’s SSH settings.
2. Find the SSH service port.
3. Use 22 if you have not changed it.

routerTrust.title: Confirm this is your router
routerTrust.description: Compare the router’s security information with the information below.

router.title: Cannot connect to the router
router.description: Check the router address and SSH username.

settings.title: Cannot verify PC power-on settings
settings.description: Check the MAC address and LAN interface.

security.title: The router security information differs
security.description: Check the router you are connecting to.

wakeReady.title: PC power-on settings checked
wakeReady.description: The required details are ready. Actual wake behavior depends on the PC power state and network.

remoteIntent.title: Connect from a different network too?
remoteIntent.description: Use OpenVPN when your phone and PC are on different networks.

vpn.installDescription: Install OpenVPN to connect from another network.
vpn.profileDescription: Import a profile in OpenVPN first.
vpn.selectDescription: This profile will be used to connect to your PC from another network.
vpn.checkErrorDescription: There was a problem checking the app. Try again or set it up later.

summary.description: Save to use PC Control with these settings.

saveFailure.title: Could not save settings
saveFailure.description: Try again shortly. Your entries will remain until you leave this screen.

complete.title: Setup is complete
complete.description: You can now check and control the connected PC.
complete.note: You can change these features later in Settings.
